title: ONNX 1.15.0 failing to install on Linux
body:
# Bug Report

### Is the issue related to model conversion?
No

### Describe the bug


### System information
<!--
- OS Platform and Distribution (*e.g. Linux Ubuntu 20.04*):  Linux amd64/ Linux ppc64le/ Linux s390x
- ONNX version (*e.g. 1.13*): 1.15.0
- Python version: python3.10
- GCC/Compiler version (if compiling from source):  /usr/bin/c++ and version 11.4.0
- CMake version: 3.22.1
- Protobuf version: 3.20.3
- Visual Studio version (if applicable):-->


### Reproduction instructions
```
1. Match the same requirements
2. Install ONNX 1.15.0 on Linux amd64/ Linux ppc64le/ Linux s390x
```

### Expected behavior
Expect ONNX 1.15.0 to build successfully. 

### Notes
In the stack trace above, I see the following:
`Failed building wheel for UNKNOWN`
I have never seen this before for other ONNX's versions.

comments.author: participant6
comments.body: @participant7 IAN @reporter, but after finding this thread, I realized I was trying to install a version of ONNX (1.14.1, so different from this issues original title!) that was not supported on the version of Python I was running (3.12). I used `pyenv` to switch to `3.10.10` and that fixed it.
